evals.name: document-exported-api
evals.prompt: Write package and function comments for an exported PaymentService interface and Process method.
evals.expected_output: Idiomatic Go doc comments starting with symbol name and explaining behavior, errors, and concurrency guarantees.
assertions: Package comment introduces package purpose at the top of doc.go or main file.
Function comments begin with the name of the symbol (e.g. '// Process executes...').
Documents context cancellation and returned error conditions.

evals.name: runnable-testable-example
evals.prompt: Add a runnable godoc example for a custom slugify string utility function.
evals.expected_output: An ExampleSlugify() function in a _test.go file with an '// Output:' assertion comment.
assertions: Example function is named following Go conventions (e.g. ExampleSlugify).
Includes an '// Output:' comment matching expected stdout.
Compiles and passes under go test.

evals.name: document-architecture-boundaries
evals.prompt: Document hexagonal architecture layer rules for new developers in the repository README.
evals.expected_output: Clear architectural guide covering inbound adapters, core domain, and outbound ports.
assertions: Clearly explains dependency inversion and port/adapter responsibilities.
Provides directory layout mapping to architectural concepts.
Lists forbidden import paths (e.g. core importing adapters).
